# The Python packages of the optional recognition part ("Capture reaction").
#
# Installed by "compound-registry install-recognition" into an environment of
# its own (<recognition home>/env, Python 3.12), never into the registry's
# environment. Do not edit by hand: these are the exact versions the feature
# was tested with (Phase 0, Windows 11, CPU only, torch 2.15.0+cpu).
#
# RxnScribe and MolScribe are taken from GitHub as source archives of one
# fixed commit each (no git needed). RxnScribe asks for MolScribe "from git,
# branch main"; recognition_overrides.txt replaces that by the fixed commit.
# torch and torchvision come from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu.
